fcdo.title: UK Government foreign travel advice (Open Government Licence v3.0)

entry.en: A visa is required to visit Iran unless you hold an Iranian passport.
entry.es: Se necesita visado para visitar Irán, salvo que se tenga pasaporte iraní.
entry.quote: You must have a visa to visit Iran unless you hold an Iranian passport.

entry.en: The passport must expire at least 6 months after the arrival date.
entry.es: El pasaporte debe vencer al menos 6 meses después de la fecha de llegada.
entry.quote: must have an ‘expiry date’ at least 6 months after the date you arrive

entry.en: Passport stamps from Israel or its border crossings may lead to refused entry to Iran.
entry.es: Los sellos de Israel o de sus pasos fronterizos en el pasaporte pueden provocar que se te niegue la entrada a Irán.
entry.quote: If your passport has stamps from Israel or other countries’ border crossing points with Israel, you may be refused entry to Iran.

entry.en: A polio vaccination certificate is required if you come from a polio-affected country.
entry.es: Se exige certificado de vacunación contra la polio si se llega desde un país afectado por la polio.
entry.quote: a polio vaccine if you’re coming from a polio-affected country

entry.en: Importing pork products into Iran is illegal.
entry.es: Importar productos de cerdo a Irán es ilegal.

entry.en: Visiting Kish Island must be arranged through an Iranian travel agency.
entry.es: La visita a la isla de Kish debe gestionarse a través de una agencia de viajes iraní.
entry.quote: To enter Kish Island, you must arrange your visit through an Iranian travel agency.

safety.en: There is a very high risk of arrest, questioning and detention for British and British-Iranian dual nationals.
safety.es: Existe un riesgo muy alto de arresto, interrogatorio y detención para británicos y para personas con doble nacionalidad británico-iraní.
safety.quote: There is a very high risk of arrest, questioning and detention for British nationals and British-Iranian dual nationals.

safety.en: Photography near military and other government installations is strictly prohibited.
safety.es: Está estrictamente prohibido fotografiar cerca de instalaciones militares y otras instalaciones gubernamentales.
safety.quote: Photography near military and other government installations is strictly prohibited.

safety.en: Terrorists are likely to try to carry out attacks in Iran.
safety.es: Es probable que los terroristas intenten llevar a cabo ataques en Irán.
safety.quote: Terrorists are likely to try to carry out attacks in Iran.

safety.en: There have been some attacks and robberies aimed at foreigners, including attempts by thieves posing as policemen, usually in civilian clothing.
safety.es: Ha habido algunos ataques y robos dirigidos a extranjeros, incluidos intentos de ladrones que se hacen pasar por policías, normalmente vestidos de civil.
safety.quote: There have been some attacks and robberies targeted at foreign nationals and tourists, including attempted robberies by thieves posing as policemen, usually in civilian clothing.

safety.en: Alcoholic drinks containing methanol have caused deaths and serious illness in Iran.
safety.es: Las bebidas alcohólicas con metanol han causado muertes y enfermedades graves en Irán.
safety.quote: There have been deaths and cases of serious illness caused by alcoholic drinks containing methanol in Iran.

safety.en: Many parts of Iran are at risk of earthquakes and tremors.
safety.es: Muchas zonas de Irán están expuestas a terremotos y temblores.
safety.quote: Many parts of Iran are at risk of earthquakes and tremors.

health.en: The emergency medical number is 115; ask for an ambulance.
health.es: El número de emergencias médicas es el 115; pide una ambulancia.
health.quote: Dial 115 and ask for an ambulance.

health.en: Medical facilities in Iran are reasonable in the major cities but poor in remote areas.
health.es: Los centros médicos de Irán son razonables en las grandes ciudades, pero deficientes en zonas remotas.
health.quote: In general, medical facilities in Iran are reasonable in the major cities but poor in remote areas.

health.en: Shortages of some basic medicines have been reported in Iran.
health.es: Se han notificado faltas de algunos medicamentos básicos en Irán.
health.quote: There have been reported shortages of some basic medicines in Iran.

health.en: Altitude sickness is a risk in parts of Iran.
health.es: El mal de altura es un riesgo en algunas zonas de Irán.
health.quote: Altitude sickness is a risk in parts of Iran.

health.en: Tap water is safe to drink in most of the country, especially the cities.
health.es: El agua del grifo es potable en la mayor parte del país, sobre todo en las ciudades.
health.quote: Tap water is safe to drink in most of the country (and especially the cities)

health.en: For more serious cases you may need evacuation abroad for satisfactory treatment, so check that your insurance covers it.
health.es: En casos más graves puede ser necesaria una evacuación al extranjero para recibir un tratamiento satisfactorio, así que comprueba que tu seguro lo cubra.
health.quote: you may need to be evacuated to another country in order to get satisfactory treatment for more serious cases; ensure that your travel insurance covers this.

help.en: Emergency numbers in Iran are 115 for ambulance, 125 for fire and 110 for police.
help.es: Los números de emergencia en Irán son el 115 (ambulancia), el 125 (bomberos) y el 110 (policía).

help.en: The UK government will not be able to evacuate you, give face-to-face help or assist you if you get into difficulty.
help.es: El gobierno británico no podrá evacuarte, prestarte asistencia en persona ni ayudarte si tienes dificultades.
help.quote: The UK government will not be able to evacuate you, provide face-to-face assistance or help you if you get into difficulty.

help.en: In an emergency you can also call the FCDO on 020 7008 5000, available 24 hours.
help.es: En una emergencia también puedes llamar al FCDO al 020 7008 5000, las 24 horas.
help.quote: Or in an emergency you can also call FCDO: 020 7008 5000 (24 hours).

getting_in.en: All international flights to Tehran land at Imam Khomeini International Airport, 37 km southwest of the city.
getting_in.es: Todos los vuelos internacionales a Teherán aterrizan en el Aeropuerto Internacional Imam Jomeini, a 37 km al suroeste de la ciudad.
getting_in.quote: All international flights to Tehran land at the new 1 Imam Khomeini International Airport (IKA IATA) based 37 km southwest of Tehran.

getting_in.en: Dual citizens of Iran and another country may only enter Iran on their Iranian passport.
getting_in.es: Quienes tienen doble ciudadanía iraní y de otro país solo pueden entrar en Irán con su pasaporte iraní.
getting_in.quote: Dual citizens of Iran and a second country may only enter Iran on their Iranian passport, as the country does not normally recognize dual citizenships.

getting_in.en: To reach a domestic flight from Imam Khomeini you would have to change airports to Mehrabad, 40 km away.
getting_in.es: Para tomar un vuelo nacional desde Imam Jomeini habría que cambiar de aeropuerto a Mehrabad, a 40 km.
getting_in.quote: If you are not staying in Tehran and planning to get to any city other than Tehran upon your arrival, you would have to change airports, from Imam Khomeini to Mehrabad, 40 km away, to get to your domestic flight.

getting_in.en: Due to sanctions there are no direct flights from Canada or the United States.
getting_in.es: Debido a las sanciones no hay vuelos directos desde Canadá ni Estados Unidos.
getting_in.quote: Due to sanctions there are no direct flights from Canada or the United States

getting_in.en: The train from Turkey leaves Van eastbound on Monday and Thursday at 20:00, reaching Tabriz next morning and Tehran 12 hours later.
getting_in.es: El tren desde Turquía sale de Van hacia el este los lunes y jueves a las 20:00 y llega a Tabriz a la mañana siguiente y a Teherán 12 horas después.
getting_in.quote: Eastbound it leaves Van on Monday and Thursday at 20:00, reaching Tabriz about 06:15 next morning and Tehran 12 hours later.

getting_around.en: The Iranian domestic bus network is extensive and very cheap thanks to low fuel costs.
getting_around.es: La red de autobuses nacional de Irán es extensa y muy barata gracias al bajo coste del combustible.
getting_around.quote: The Iranian domestic bus network is extensive and thanks to the low cost of fuel, very cheap.

getting_around.en: Trains, called ghatar in Persian, are described as probably the cheapest, safest, most reliable and easiest way to travel around the country.
getting_around.es: Los trenes, llamados ghatar en persa, se describen como probablemente la forma más barata, segura, fiable y fácil de recorrer el país.
getting_around.quote: Known as a "ghatar" in Persian; trains are probably the cheapest, safest, most reliable and easiest way to travel around the country.

getting_around.en: Iranian airlines link Tehran with most regional capitals, with inter-regional flights for no more than US$60.
getting_around.es: Las aerolíneas iraníes unen Teherán con la mayoría de las capitales regionales, con vuelos interregionales de no más de 60 US$.
getting_around.quote: link Tehran with most regional capitals and offer inter-regional flights for no more than US$60.

getting_around.en: Ride-hailing apps similar to Uber, mainly Snapp and Tap30, are available in the major cities.
getting_around.es: Hay aplicaciones de transporte similares a Uber, principalmente Snapp y Tap30, en las grandes ciudades.
getting_around.quote: There are several popular ride hailing services available in the major cities similar to Uber. Snapp and Tap30 are the major applications which can be installed on iOS and Android devices for free.

getting_around.en: For trips between cities up to 250 km apart you may be able to hire a shared savari taxi near bus terminals and train stations.
getting_around.es: Para viajes entre ciudades de hasta 250 km se puede contratar un taxi compartido savari cerca de las terminales de autobús y estaciones de tren.
getting_around.quote: When travelling between cities up to 250 km apart, you may be able to hire one of the shared savāri taxis that loiter around bus terminals and train stations.

getting_around.en: Tehran has 7 metro lines, one of which is essentially a suburban line going to Karaj and beyond.
getting_around.es: Teherán tiene 7 líneas de metro, una de las cuales es básicamente una línea suburbana hacia Karaj y más allá.
getting_around.quote: Tehran has 7 metro lines. One of these is essentially a suburban line going to Karaj and beyond.

money.en: Western credit and debit cards do not work in Iran because of sanctions.
money.es: Las tarjetas de crédito y débito occidentales no funcionan en Irán por las sanciones.
money.quote: Due to western sanctions against Iran, Western credit and debit cards do not work in Iran.

money.en: Getting cash in Iran is extremely difficult and non-Iranian debit and cash cards will not work.
money.es: Conseguir efectivo en Irán es extremadamente difícil y las tarjetas de débito y cajero no iraníes no funcionan.
money.quote: Getting cash in Iran is extremely difficult. Non-Iranian debit and cash cards will not work in Iran.

money.en: Prices in Iran may be shown in toman, where 1 toman equals 10 rials.
money.es: Los precios en Irán pueden expresarse en tomanes, donde 1 toman equivale a 10 rials.
money.quote: In Iran, prices may be shown in toman (تومان), where 1 toman = 10 rials.

money.en: The most widely accepted currencies are US dollars and euros.
money.es: Las monedas más aceptadas son el dólar estadounidense y el euro.
money.quote: The most widely-accepted currencies are US dollar and euros.

money.en: Changing money on the street is illegal.
money.es: Cambiar dinero en la calle es ilegal.
money.quote: It’s illegal to change money on the street.

money.en: Wire transfers to or from Iranian bank accounts are not possible because of sanctions.
money.es: No es posible hacer transferencias a cuentas bancarias iraníes ni desde ellas debido a las sanciones.
money.quote: Due to Western sanctions, it is not possible to wire transfer money to or from Iranian bank accounts.

etiquette.en: A man should not try to shake hands with a woman unless she raises her hand first.
etiquette.es: Un hombre no debe intentar estrechar la mano a una mujer a menos que ella extienda la suya primero.
etiquette.quote: But if you are a man, do not attempt to shake hands with a woman unless she voluntarily raises her hand.

etiquette.en: Bring a headscarf with you just in case.
etiquette.es: Lleva un pañuelo para la cabeza por si acaso.
etiquette.quote: Make sure you at least bring a headscarf with you just in case.

etiquette.en: In public, women are expected to cover everything but their face, hands and feet.
etiquette.es: En público se espera que las mujeres cubran todo menos la cara, las manos y los pies.
etiquette.quote: when in public women are expected to cover everything but their face, hands and feet.

etiquette.en: For men, shorts and three-quarter length trousers are only acceptable on the beach.
etiquette.es: Para los hombres, los pantalones cortos y de tres cuartos solo son aceptables en la playa.
etiquette.quote: Shorts and three-quarter length trousers are only acceptable on the beach.

etiquette.en: Under tarof, a host is obliged to offer anything a guest might want and the guest is equally obliged to refuse it.
etiquette.es: Según el tarof, el anfitrión debe ofrecer cualquier cosa que el invitado pueda querer y el invitado debe rechazarla.
etiquette.quote: Tarof also governs the rules of hospitality: a host is obliged to offer anything a guest might want, and a guest is equally obliged to refuse it.

etiquette.en: Avoid bringing material critical of the Iranian government into Iran.
etiquette.es: Evita llevar a Irán material crítico con el gobierno iraní.
etiquette.quote: Avoid bringing material critical of the Iranian government to Iran.

connectivity.en: Irancell, MCI, Iran Taliya and Rightel offer prepaid SIM cards for international travelers at a very modest cost.
connectivity.es: Irancell, MCI, Iran Taliya y Rightel ofrecen tarjetas SIM de prepago para viajeros internacionales a muy bajo coste.
connectivity.quote: Irancell (MTN), MCI, Iran Taliya, and Rightel offer pre-paid SIM cards for international travelers at a very modest cost.

connectivity.en: To buy a SIM card you need a copy of your passport information page and of the page with the Iranian visa and entrance seal.
connectivity.es: Para comprar una SIM se necesita una copia de la página de datos del pasaporte y de la página con el visado iraní y el sello de entrada.
connectivity.quote: With a copy of the information page of your passport and a copy of the page with Iranian visa and entrance seal, you can buy SIM cards and access the internet

connectivity.en: Some websites, including Facebook and YouTube, are blocked in Iran.
connectivity.es: Algunos sitios web, incluidos Facebook y YouTube, están bloqueados en Irán.
connectivity.quote: However, some websites, including Facebook and YouTube, are blocked in Iran.

connectivity.en: Iranians commonly use VPNs to get around blocks, even though Iran is among the few countries that ban VPN use.
connectivity.es: Los iraníes suelen usar VPN para sortear los bloqueos, aunque Irán es uno de los pocos países que prohíben su uso.
connectivity.quote: Iranians commonly use VPNs to get around blocks, even though Iran is among the few countries that ban VPN use.

connectivity.en: Iranian authorities have in the past blocked, significantly slowed or shut down landline, internet and mobile services without warning.
connectivity.es: Las autoridades iraníes han bloqueado, ralentizado considerablemente o cortado sin aviso servicios de telefonía fija, internet y móvil.
connectivity.quote: Iranian authorities have blocked, significantly slowed or shut down landline, internet and mobile services without warning in the past.
